# Atomic Constraint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/AtomicConstraint>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)

A single ODRL constraint comparison: a [`gmeow:leftOperand`](../properties/gmeow-leftOperand.md) (the dimension tested), a [`gmeow:constraintOperator`](../properties/gmeow-constraintOperator.md) (the comparison), and a [`gmeow:rightOperand`](../properties/gmeow-rightOperand.md) (the value). E.g. [`leftOperand`](../properties/gmeow-leftOperand.md) dateTime, operator lteq, [`rightOperand`](../properties/gmeow-rightOperand.md) 2030-01-01 — 'valid until 2030'.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Constraint`](gmeow-Constraint.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:AtomicConstraint`](gmeow-AtomicConstraint.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Constraint`](gmeow-Constraint.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
